title: The Convergent Ethics of AI? Analyzing Moral Foundation Priorities in Large Language Models with a Multi-Framework Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to classic ethical dilemmas (e.g., Trolley Problem, Heinz Dilemma) and direct questioning using the PRIME framework, which incorporates Moral Foundations Theory, Kohlberg's Stages of Moral Development, and consequentialist-deontological dichotomies to identify systematic prioritization of specific moral dimensions (e.g., Care/Harm and Fairness/Cheating over Authority and Sanctity).

Analyzing the systematic underweighting of culturally-specific moral foundations like authority, loyalty, and sanctity in model outputs, and comparing LLM decisions in game-theoretic scenarios and ethical dilemmas against human baseline behaviors primarily derived from adult respondents in Western Industrial settings.
